unit.why: A footnote, mostly a halakhic and homiletic discussion of blessings over bread, which contains a brief anecdote about R. Zusha fasting three days over an improperly intended blessing.
unit.boundary_note: footnote attached to the preceding main text; ends with a running header '30 תפארת פרשת ע'

stories.start_quote: שמעתי מהחסיד הצדיק מוה׳ זושא זללה"ה
stories.summary_en: R. Zusha once fasted three days because, when he said the blessing over bread, he also had in mind his own pleasure in satisfying his hunger. The anecdote becomes a homily on blessing God purely for His creation.
